## For Collaboration

I am interested in PhD, predoc/RA, and research-collaboration opportunities for the 2027 entry and application cycle. My contribution is strongest where a project needs careful longitudinal data construction, relational measurement, spatial/network analysis, and conservative interpretation of scientific-career or high-skilled mobility evidence.

:::

::: {.page-band .surface}

## Research Objects

::: {.capability-grid .capability-grid-five}
::: {.capability-panel}
### Scientific careers
Career stages, appointments, institutional movement, and temporal ordering.
:::
::: {.capability-panel}

:::

### Collaboration networks
Coauthorship, ego networks, tie persistence, and relational capital.
:::
::: {.capability-panel}
### Organisations
Universities, research institutes, firms, and platform histories.
:::
::: {.capability-panel}

Urban opportunity structures, spatial constraints, and regional innovation contexts.

## Data Capabilities

::: {.method-chain}
::: {.method-row}
### Longitudinal Career Reconstruction

I can help build source-audited career histories that distinguish education, employment, publication affiliation, and verified mobility events.
:::

::: {.method-row}
### Publication and Institution Linkage

I work with bibliometric records, affiliation strings, institution-city matching, ROR/OpenAlex/Scopus workflows, and uncertainty documentation.
:::

::: {.method-row}
### Relational and Spatial Datasets

I can construct coauthor networks, mobility networks, candidate-destination structures, city-level attributes, and spatially joined research datasets.
:::

::: {.method-row}
### Entity Matching and Integration

Current work includes identity matching, temporal validation, conflict logs, synthetic fixtures, and reproducible pipelines for large relational datasets.
:::
:::

:::

::: {.page-band .surface}

## Analytical Capabilities

::: {.profile-grid .profile-grid-three}
::: {.profile-item}
### Choice modelling
Event-specific candidate sets, conditional logit, clustered robust inference, and temporal measurement.
:::
::: {.profile-item}
### Network analysis
Directed weighted networks, centrality, ego networks, WERGM, proximity, and tie persistence.
:::
::: {.profile-item}
### Spatial and longitudinal design
GIS, city matching, temporal comparison, reproducible Python/R/Stata workflows, and source-conflict auditing.
:::
